parsed.rationale: Both participating records — `PlayerControllerTestHarness.postInterruptionBegan` (line 353) and `PlayerControllerTestHarness.postInterruptionEnded` (line 367) — carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTestUtilities/Harness/PlayerControllerTestHarness.swift`. Per the decision rules, any cluster where even one record is test-marked must be treated as a test fixture and left unchanged. These two methods are deliberate test-harness helpers that simulate distinct audio-interruption lifecycle events; their structural similarity (Jaccard 0.83) reflects the symmetric nature of began/ended event pairs, not accidental duplication. Genericizing them would obscure the semantic distinction between the two interruption states and couple production-facing generic machinery to test-only infrastructure.
